最高のワークライフを送れるよう、さまざまな福利厚生をご用意しています。これには、多数のホテルでの宿泊割引、リチャージ・デイ、年間を通じたボランティア・デーなどが含まれます。マイウェルビーイング・フレームワークを通じて、健康、ライフスタイル、職場におけるウェルビーイングのサポートに取り組んでいます。当ホテルはユニークで包括的な企業文化を提供しており、そこには常に、所属し、成長し、変化をもたらすための「あなたのための部屋」があります。

私たちの使命は、すべての人を歓迎し、違いを認め合い、従業員が自分らしさを発揮できるような、インクルーシブなチームを作ることです。IHGホテルズ＆リゾーツは、人種、肌の色、宗教、性別、性的指向、性自認、国籍、退役軍人の地位、障害の有無にかかわらず、応募者と従業員に均等な雇用機会を提供します。当社は、信頼、サポート、受容の文化を推進しています。異なる背景、経験、考え方を常に歓迎します。

日々の業務

日本&ミクロネシアは成長が著しい地域の為、複数のホテルを担当いただく、ポートフォーリオレベニューマネージャーを募集いたします。IHG レベニューチームの一員として、契約ホテルを担当し、積極的かつ効果的なレベニューマネジメント、RevPar及びRGIを指標として競合ホテルよりも優れたパフォーマンス、ポートフォーリオホテルの予算目標達成が責務となります。主に客室売上に注力していただきますが、今後は宴会や料飲部門にも関わっていく予定です。

応募資格

最低5年間のホテル業界での職務経験があり、その内最低3年間のクラスター/ポートフォーリオレベニューマネージメントに携わった経験が望ましい。

国際的に認められたホスピタリティーの学位の保持者、あるいはセールス＆マーケティングに関わった経験があり、CRS（Concerto, Trust, Marsha等, PMS(Opera)、レベニューマネージメントのシステム（Optims, Ideas, Rategain, Perform & Price Optimization）に精通している事。

自主的に働きながら、ステークホルダーと良好な関係を保ち、会社の目標を達成し成功に導く能力。

日本語の能力が必要です。

 

Your day to day

Due to growth and expansion in this region, we're looking for a Portfolio Revenue Manager to support a number of hotels in Japan.

You'll be an integral member of the Revenue Management for Hire team, responsible for pro-actively and cost effectively maximizing subscriber hotel room revenues, RevPAR and system delivery to achieve superior performance in comparison to the competitive set as measured in RGI and as against budget growth targets across a portfolio of hotels within the Japan and Micronesia region. Your scope of work focuses on Room Accommodations, but may include conferencing and events and food and beverage outlets as we continue to evolve our services.

You will be the key driver of revenue generation data analysis and recommend logical, tactical and strategic initiatives. You will also promote desired revenue management work culture around the five Winning Ways of Do the right thing, Show we care, Aim higher, Celebrate difference and Work better together.

What we need from you

To be successful in this role, you will have at least five years experience within the Hospitality Industry in addition to a minimum of 3 years experience in a Cluster/Portfolio Revenue Management Environment.

You will currently hold an internationally recognized Degree in Hospitality or Sales & Marketing related field and have proven knowledge of Central Reservation Systems (Holidex Plus/Trust/Marsha), Property Management Systems (Opera) and Revenue Management Software Systems (Optims, Ideas, Rategain, Perform & Price Optimization).

You will have a proven ability in exceeding company targets, managing key stakeholders and the ability to be successful whilst working autonomously.

Japanese language proficiency is essential.

Role Title: Electrical & Circuit Design Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is selection Electrical & Circuit Design Experts to contribute to a customer's project focused on advancing the capabilities of AI technologies in electrical engineering. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems.

Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required , your domain knowledge is what matters.

This is an opportunity to impact the future of engineering by ensuring that AI systems can accurately interpret, solve, and explain complex circuit design challenges across analog, digital, mixed-signal, power, and RF domains. Experts with a passion for precision, technical detail, and clear written and verbal communication will find this engagement both rewarding and influential.

Scope of Work

  1. Evaluate and solve advanced circuit design and electrical engineering problems across multiple domains, including analog, digital, mixed-signal, power, and RF circuits.
  2. Review and assess AI-generated technical responses for technical correctness, accuracy, and engineering quality.
  3. Apply practical engineering judgment to real-world design scenarios and theoretical questions.
  4. Analyze and troubleshoot a wide range of circuit types using industry-standard techniques such as Kirchhoff's laws, node-voltage analysis, small-signal analysis, and phasor analysis.
  5. Contribute domain expertise to inform model improvements and refine AI reasoning in electrical and circuit design.
  6. Document feedback and provide clear written and verbal explanations to enhance AI learning and performance.
  7. Collaborate remotely with a distributed team of experts and project participants.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, or BS in Electrical Engineering with 8+ years of relevant industry experience.
  2. At least 5 years of hands-on experience in analog, digital, mixed-signal, power, or RF circuit design, including participation in hardware that has reached production or tape-out.
  3. Expert knowledge of analog/mixed-signal design, digital logic, semiconductor devices, power electronics, RF/microwave systems, and control systems.
  4. Proven ability to analyze complex circuits using Thevenin equivalents, Hybrid-π models, FSMs, and timing analysis.
  5. Familiarity with semiconductor reliability concerns, EMC, and modern CMOS scaling.
  6. Professional English proficiency with exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  7. Experience with IC/ASIC design, EDA tools (Cadence, Synopsys, Mentor Graphics), PCB design, or high-speed digital/RF system validation is a plus.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based; experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete work may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow. Minimum submission requirements apply. Experts must submit a minimum of tasks per week.

Start Timeline & Availability

We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts ready to jump in right away. If selected, we expect you to start your first tasks within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

raw.title: The Deep Learning Indaba Talent Pipeline
raw.excerpt: About AminiAmini builds the sovereign, AI-native infrastructure stack for Africa and the Global South: the data, compute, and connectivity that let governments and enterprises own their digital future instead of renting it from someone else.
raw.description:
About Amini

Amini builds the sovereign, AI-native infrastructure stack for Africa and the Global South: the data, compute, and connectivity that let governments and enterprises own their digital future instead of renting it from someone else. We already work with governments across a dozen countries and our work has been recognised by TIME100 AI, MIT Solve, and the World Economic Forum. Put simply, we help our partners put AI to work in ways that actually move the needle, and we make sure that opportunity doesn't stay locked up in a handful of countries.

We live by five values: Collaboration, Trust, Integrity, Humility, and Passion. That's not a poster on the wall. It shows up in how we work day to day: sharing credit and information by default, being upfront about what we don't know yet, and owning a mistake early instead of protecting an ego.

We're small, sharp, and deliberately non-hierarchical. Everyone here knows the work is genuinely transformational, but we try to stay humble about it. We want people who'll bring their full skill set, share ideas without ego, and help us grow our impact, from the governments and communities we already serve today into something much bigger across Africa and the Global South and the AI industry at large.

We're three years in and hitting a genuinely exciting point. The early years were about proving the model. Having done that with governments in specific regions we're now scaling into multiple global regions at once, and that means we need sharp people across more disciplines than ever.

Why We're At the Indaba

This year's Indaba theme, Sovereign Intelligence: Africa's Path in a Frontier AI World, is basically a description of what we do at Amini every single day. We build the sovereign data, compute, and connectivity infrastructure that lets African governments and enterprises own and direct their own AI future, instead of depending on outside platforms. We are excited to meet like minded AI practitioners and technologists with the talent, ideas, and ambition, that's why we're in Lagos, and why we want to meet you there.

About This Talent Pipeline

This isn't a job ad for one role. It's how we're building our talent pipeline, straight from the Deep Learning Indaba community: researchers, students, and practitioners from across Africa and beyond who believe the continent's AI future should be built and owned here. Amini is scaling fast across Software Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Data Science, Machine Learning, Ops, and Commercial, and we'd rather start building a relationship with great people now, before we have the exact role that fits.

Register your interest and you're in the pool of candidates our team actively reviews as new roles open. We'll reach out directly the moment there's a match, whether that's in a few weeks or once we've launched in a new market.

Why Amini

  • Real impact, not theoretical impact: we work directly with governments across the Global South, building infrastructure that hands countries back ownership of their own digital and AI future.
  • The recognition follows the work: TIME100 AI, MIT Solve, and the World Economic Forum have all taken notice of what we're building.
  • You'd be joining at exactly the right moment: we're moving from proving the model in one market to scaling across several at once, a genuinely rare stage to join.
  • A culture that's actually flat: small, sharp, non-hierarchical teams who share credit, share information, and admit what they don't know.
  • Your work won't disappear into a big organisation: our teams are small enough that what you do has a direct line to real outcomes for governments and citizens.
  • Fully remote working
  • Travel opportunities
  • Competitive salary and benefits package

Where We Will be Hiring

We're an infratech company building sovereign data, compute, and connectivity, so we hire across a genuinely wide spread of disciplines, and we expect this list to keep growing as we scale:

  • Software Engineering
  • Hardware Engineering
  • Machine Learning
  • Data Science
  • Civil Engineering
  • Customer Success
  • Programme Management (PMO)
  • Marketing
  • Sales / Business Development
  • Operations
  • Product Management
  • Research & Development

Don't see your discipline? If you think there's a place for you at Amini as we grow, we still want to hear from you.

What We Look For

  • A real interest in the Global South, and in building infrastructure that shifts who owns and governs digital and AI capability.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. This is early-stage and fast-scaling, so you'll be helping build the playbook, not just following one.
  • Genuine alignment with our values: collaboration, trust, integrity, humility, and passion.
  • Wherever it's relevant to your discipline, exposure to infrastructure, government, sovereign cloud, data residency, or emerging markets is a big plus, though not essential.

What Happens After You Register

A few weeks after the Indaba, we'll invite everyone who's registered to a Teams call. Expect to hear about Amini, what our mission actually looks like in practice, and what it's like to work here day to day, plus a few of our own team will jump on to talk honestly about their experience, the good parts and the hard parts.

We'll be straight with you: we might not have a live role the moment you register. But when we are hiring, our talent database is the first place we look, before anywhere else. Registering and joining that call is a genuine way to build a relationship with us, not a CV disappearing into a folder.

Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.


At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.


Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.


Genesys is seeking a strategic and execution-oriented Director of Outbound Engagement to lead the evolution of our outbound engagement capabilities across voice and digital channels. This leader will drive the transformation of traditional outbound communications into intelligent, AI-driven engagement experiences powered by agentic virtual agents, orchestration, and omni-channel customer journeys. The role is responsible for defining and executing the product strategy that expands Genesys outbound solutions beyond traditional contact center use cases into broader sales, marketing, customer engagement, collections, retention, and proactive service workflows.

This position requires a strong blend of product strategy, AI and automation vision, platform thinking, commercial awareness, and operational execution. The ideal candidate understands how AI agents, orchestration, compliance, campaign management, and customer engagement technologies converge to create scalable enterprise value.

Key Responsibilities:

Strategic Product Leadership

  • Define and drive the multi-year strategy for Genesys outbound engagement platforms across voice, SMS, email, messaging, and emerging digital channels.

  • Lead the evolution of outbound solutions to incorporate AI-powered and agentic virtual agents capable of proactive customer engagement and workflow automation.

  • Expand outbound platform capabilities into new business domains including sales engagement, marketing outreach, customer retention, collections, and proactive customer care.

  • Identify new emerging outbound channels, customer pain points, and competitive gaps to shape platform investments and roadmap priorities.

  • Partner with executive leadership to align Genesys outbound strategy with broader company AI, cloud, and customer experience initiatives.

AI & Automation Innovation

  • Drive adoption of agentic AI capabilities including intelligent campaign orchestration, conversational AI, proactive outreach, adaptive engagement, and workflow automation.

  • Evaluate where AI delivers measurable customer and business value versus where deterministic automation or workflow orchestration is more appropriate.

  • Establish scalable approaches for integrating large language models, orchestration frameworks, knowledge systems, and enterprise data into outbound workflows.

  • Define governance approaches for AI-driven outbound engagement including compliance, trust, explainability, observability, cost management, and operational controls.

Platform & Product Execution

  • Lead cross-functional teams responsible for roadmap execution across outbound campaign management, contact list management, dialling, digital engagement, orchestration, and AI-powered engagement capabilities.

  • Partner closely with Engineering, Architecture, Data Science, UX, Operations, and GTM teams to deliver scalable platform capabilities.

  • Drive platform modernization initiatives focused on scalability, cloud-native architecture, compliance automation, and operational efficiency.

  • Prioritize reusable platform services and shared capabilities to reduce duplication and accelerate innovation.

  • Balance customer requests, market demands, platform sustainability, and operational economics in roadmap prioritization.

Market Expansion & Commercial Growth

  • Develop strategies to grow and modernize the existing outbound business while expanding into adjacent engagement and revenue-generating use cases.

  • Collaborate with Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing teams to support customer adoption and market positioning.

  • Engage directly with strategic customers, partners, analysts, and internal stakeholders to validate direction and influence roadmap priorities.

  • Support business case development, investment prioritization, and strategic planning activities.

Required Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of product management, platform strategy, or product leadership experience in enterprise software, cloud platforms, contact center, customer engagement, marketing technology, or communications platforms.

  • Experience leading large-scale outbound engagement, communications, campaign management, or customer interaction platforms.

  • Strong understanding of AI, automation, conversational AI, virtual agents, and orchestration technologies.

  • Experience delivering enterprise SaaS or cloud-native platform capabilities.

  • Demonstrated ability to define strategy and execute across complex cross-functional organizations.

  • Strong commercial and business acumen with experience driving growth-oriented platform initiatives.

  • Experience working with executive stakeholders and enterprise customers.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with CCaaS, CPaaS, outbound dialing, campaign management, sales engagement, or marketing automation platforms.

  • Understanding of AI operational governance including model cost management, trust and safety, observability, compliance, and human-in-the-loop controls.

  • Familiarity with omni-channel engagement platforms including voice, messaging, email, and digital channels.

  • Experience with enterprise-scale AI transformation initiatives.

  • Background in regulated outbound communications environments.

Success Measures:

  • ARR growth of outbound revenue

  • Delivery and adoption of AI powered outbound workflows and Proactive engagement attach rate

  • Reduction in configuration and operational complexity

  • Expansion into new outbound engagement use cases

  • Platform scalability and operational efficiency

  • Strategic roadmap execution

  • Commercial impact and market differentiation


Working at Genesys

  • AI at enterprise scale – Build, support and operate AI-powered technology used by more than 8,000 organizations worldwide. 150+ new AI features were released in the last fiscal year.

Lumanity is dedicated to improving patient health by accelerating and optimizing access to medical advances. We’re looking for a brilliant individual to join our team as a Medical Writer who demonstrates an excellent scientific understanding, an ability to tell a scientific story that resonates with the target audience, a passion for communications and outstanding writing skills.

Ideal candidates will have a precise attention to detail and thrive on working at pace, whilst being able to effortlessly manage different priorities.

Responsibilities will include:

2026-4550

Job Summary

Artemis is seeking a full-time Communications Specialist with demonstrated experience developing and editing documentation, reports, and communications for federal clients. Working with the Department of Veterans Affairs’ (VA), Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Digital Health Office’s Strategic Initiatives Lab, this role produces clear, accurate, and audience-appropriate user manuals, technical documentation, briefing materials, and evaluation reports, and edits deliverables for quality, consistency, and compliance.

The Communications Specialist role requires a self-starter, proactive problem solver and action-oriented team player with exceptional writing, editing, and attention to detail. This position requires an individual who is committed to providing superior service, poised under pressure and has a positive and flexible attitude.

This is a contingent hire position. Offers will be contingent upon client approval, ability to meet security requirements, and the ability to adhere to any on-site requirements (which may change at contract award).

Remote work is anticipated. However, occasional travel for client engagements may be required.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Create and maintain detailed user manuals, technical documentation, and FAQs for digital health products.
  • Draft, format, and edit monthly reports, briefing decks, and informational materials for program and executive audiences.
  • Edit and quality-check deliverables in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint for clarity, accuracy, consistency, and adherence to style standards.
  • Develop and refine strategic communication artifacts such as brochures, toolkits, flyers, and manuals.
  • Support the drafting of evaluation reports, project completion reports, and research summaries, incorporating graphics and data as needed.
  • Assist with drafting and formatting language for use in applicable VA and Veterans Health Administration policies, directives, and guidance documents.
  • Translate complex technical and clinical concepts into clear, accessible content for diverse stakeholders, including Veterans, clinicians, and VA leadership.
  • Collaborate with subject matter experts to gather source material and ensure documentation remains current and accurate.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3 years of experience in technical writing, editing, or communications.
  • Bachelor’s degree in English, communications, journalism, technical writing, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience producing user manuals, technical documentation, reports, and briefing materials.
  • Strong editing and proofreading skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to translate complex or technical information into clear, audience-appropriate content.
  • Experience supporting complex projects and transformation efforts within the federal government.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a public trust clearance.
  • Legal authorization to work in the U.S.

Desired Qualifications

  • Strong critical thinking, analytical, and time management skills.
  • Proven ability to organize, prioritize, and work well with others.
  • Ability to communicate thoughts, ideas, and solutions logically both written and orally.
  • Ability to stay calm under pressure in a fast-paced environment and understand complex issues quickly.
  • Ability to receive feedback from clients and implement changes quickly and effectively.
  • Desire to work in a fast-paced, rapidly evolving environment.

JOIN THE BEST TEAM IN SPORT & SPIRIT

At Varsity Brands, we believe every student deserves the opportunity to succeed and every educator wants to make a difference. It takes a team to make a real impact, and through our two divisions – BSN SPORTS and Varsity Spirit – and our network of 6,000+ employees and independent representatives, we are proud to partner with a wide range of educational institutions and club and professional sports to transform the student journey in SPORT and SPIRIT.

LOCATION: Remote

HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT:

Varsity Brands is building a modern, unified digital platform that powers the full experience of sport and spirit, connecting product configuration, ordering, fulfillment, manufacturing readiness, customer engagement, and business operations through scalable, API-driven services and shared platform capabilities. The Lead Software Engineer serves as a senior technical leader responsible for designing and delivering complex platform capabilities that span multiple engineering teams, applications, and services. This role provides technical leadership beyond an individual team, influencing architecture decisions, engineering standards, platform strategy, and software delivery practices across the organization.

The Lead Software Engineer combines deep technical expertise with systems thinking, helping engineering teams solve complex technical challenges while ensuring solutions align with Varsity Brands’ long-term platform vision. This role serves as a trusted advisor to engineering leadership and plays a critical role in developing engineering talent, driving modernization efforts, and accelerating platform transformation.

The Lead Software Engineer helps scale Varsity Brands’ technology capabilities by creating reusable solutions, improving platform consistency, and strengthening engineering execution across teams.

This role contributes to:

  • Improved scalability, reliability, and performance of platform services

  • Greater reuse of shared services and architectural patterns

  • Accelerated modernization of legacy applications and technology platforms

  • Improved engineering productivity and delivery effectiveness

  • Increased technical capability through mentorship and coaching

  • Reduced technical debt and operational complexity

  • Stronger alignment between engineering decisions and business objectives

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Lead architecture and design efforts for complex applications, services, and platform capabilities

  • Drive technical decision-making across multiple teams and technology domains

  • Establish scalable, maintainable, and secure architecture patterns

  • Promote consistency in engineering approaches, frameworks, and development standards

  • Review and influence major technical designs and implementation strategies

  • Ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture principles and platform strategy

Platform Engineering & Modernization

  • Lead development of reusable platform services and shared engineering capabilities

  • Drive modernization initiatives supporting cloud-native, API-first, and event-driven architectures

  • Identify opportunities to simplify systems, eliminate duplication, and improve maintainability

  • Guide technical debt reduction efforts and platform optimization initiatives

  • Promote engineering practices that improve reliability, scalability, and operational performance

Engineering Excellence

  • Establish and promote engineering best practices across development teams

  • Drive adoption of automated testing, CI/CD, observability, and DevOps practices

  • Improve software quality through design reviews, code reviews, and technical coaching

  • Champion performance, security, resiliency, and operational excellence standards

  • Support continuous improvement of engineering processes and delivery methods

Technical Mentorship & Talent Development

  • Mentor Software Engineers I, II, and III while helping prepare future Lead Engineers

  • Provide technical coaching and career guidance to engineers across the organization

  • Share knowledge through architecture reviews, design discussions, and technical forums

  • Help establish a culture of learning, collaboration, and engineering excellence

  • Serve as a role model for technical leadership without formal authority

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Product Management, Design, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security, and Engineering teams

  • Translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions

  • Evaluate tradeoffs involving performance, reliability, security, cost, and maintainability

  • Influence technology roadmaps and engineering priorities

  • Drive alignment among stakeholders with varying technical and business objectives

Key Performance Indicators

Success in this role will be measured through:

  • Scalability, reliability, and performance of platform services

  • Adoption of architectural standards and reusable engineering patterns

  • Reduction in technical debt and operational complexity

  • Engineering productivity improvements

  • Effectiveness of technical mentorship and talent development

  • Contribution to modernization and platform transformation initiatives

  • Influence on engineering quality and technical decision-making

QUALIFICATIONS:

The ideal candidate will demonstrate the following capabilities:

Platform Leadership

  • Thinks beyond individual applications to platforms, systems, and reusable capabilities

  • Designs solutions that scale across products, teams, and business functions

  • Balances immediate delivery needs with long-term architectural objectives

Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of software architecture, distributed systems, cloud-native development, APIs, and modern engineering practices

  • Strong knowledge of performance optimization, resiliency, security, and system design

  • Ability to evaluate and implement scalable engineering solutions

Strategic Problem Solving

  • Solves highly complex technical challenges involving multiple systems and stakeholders

  • Applies systems thinking to identify root causes and long-term solutions

  • Anticipates technical risks and proactively mitigates issues

Influence & Collaboration

  • Influences technical decisions without formal authority

  • Builds alignment among engineering teams and business stakeholders

  • Communicates complex technical concepts in clear and accessible language

Technical Mentorship

  • Develops engineering talent through coaching, mentorship, and technical leadership

  • Promotes continuous learning and engineering excellence

  • Helps elevate technical capability across the organization

Education, Certification and Experience

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or related technical discipline; or equivalent combination of education and experience

  • 8–12+ years of progressive software engineering experience

  • Demonstrated experience leading architecture and technical design across multiple systems or teams

  • Experience building scalable applications, APIs, distributed systems, and cloud-native solutions

  • Experience mentoring engineers and influencing engineering standards

Preferred:

Inbound & Outbound Caller - STERRY Limited
Location: Remote
Job Type: Full-time

Join a dynamic growth marketing agency where precision meets creativity
At STERRY, we're not your average marketing agency—we're the rocket fuel behind crowdfunding and e-commerce success. Since day one, we've helped clients generate over $100 million in trackable online revenue through strategies rooted in measurable performance.

The Role
We are looking for a proactive and customer-focused Inbound & Outbound Caller to manage incoming calls, proactively handle outbound calls, and inquiries for our e-commerce, public relations, and marketing services. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator who can provide exceptional customer support, assist with order- and service-related concerns, and ensure every customer interaction reflects our commitment to quality and professionalism.

What You'll Do
  • Answer inbound calls from customers, clients, and business partners in a professional and friendly manner.
  • Proactively make outbound calls when necessary to follow up on customer inquiries, confirm order details, or provide delivery updates.
  • Respond to inquiries related to products, online orders, deliveries, marketing campaigns, and company services across both retail and wholesale channels.
  • Assist customers with order tracking, returns, exchanges, refunds, and general account inquiries.
  • Support wholesale and retail order processing by helping customers place new orders, verifying product availability, and accurately entering order details into the system.
  • Handle client inquiries regarding marketing or PR services and direct them to the appropriate team when needed.
  • Manage email support for both retail and wholesale customers, responding to initial order inquiries, order confirmations, and post-purchase questions.
  • Ensure timely and professional email correspondence, addressing customer concerns and providing accurate information regarding products, pricing, and shipping.
  • Accurately document all customer interactions—both inbound calls and outbound communications—and maintain up-to-date records in the CRM system.
  • Resolve customer concerns promptly or escalate complex issues to the appropriate department.
  • Escalate complex or unresolved issues to the appropriate department (E-commerce, Marketing, PR, Operations, or Wholesale & Retail teams) with clear and thorough documentation.
  • Meet or exceed customer service performance metrics, including response time, call quality, email reply speed, and customer satisfaction scores.
Who You Are
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Business, or related field is a plus— but what truly matters is what you can build. A standout portfolio or equivalent hands-on experience is just as valued.
  • At least 2 years of customer service, call center, e-commerce, or client support experience is preferred.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and conflict-resolution abilities.
  • Comfortable using CRM systems, order management platforms, and basic office software.
  • Ability to multitask and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Willingness to work flexible schedules when required.
What You'll Bring
  • Experience supporting e-commerce platforms (e.g., Shopify, WooCommerce, Amazon, or similar).
  • Familiarity with digital marketing, public relations, or client services is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Customer-first mindset with a positive and professional attitude.
  • Ability to build rapport with customers and clients while maintaining professionalism.
Apply
Send your resume and a short cover letter via our Jazz HR portal. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
STERRY Limited is an equal opportunity employer.

Our process includes a HireVue assessment for all applicants for this requisition. Our recruiting team reviews each submission, and selected candidates will have the chance to meet with a member of the team.

This is a remote position. Preference will be given to candidates located in Denver, CO, Salt Lake City, UT, or Las Vegas, NV to best support business needs. Candidates located in Arizona or California will also be considered. Please note that if an office or hub opens within a reasonable commuting distance, full-time in-office work may be required.

Responsibilities include:

  • Support the site search process and preparation of options for presentation to brand leadership.
  • Support event activities for industry events including pre-planning and onsite delivery.
  • Working closely and in collaboration with event and brand leadership to drive all event strategies through management of detailed project plans, program of events and budget guidelines.

Job Title: Principal Software Development Engineer (PBM AI Solutions)

Job Location: Work at Home, Illinois, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Role Summary

At CVS Health®, you’ll be working with a team of passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold themselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Do you enjoy innovation while having fun doing it? If the answer yes, then this role might be for you! Join us and be part of something bigger, innovative and simplification in healthcare.

We are seeking a highly experienced and innovative Principal (Director Level) Software Development Engineer to lead the application architecture, design, development, delivery of next-generation digital applications (including Reporting and financial solutions), and optimization of scalable, secure, and high-performance solutions leveraging AI across all major cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, and GCP). This role requires deep technical expertise, AI-enabled solutions, strategic thinking, scalable digital platforms, and enterprise integrations that power critical healthcare and pharmacy experiences and a passion for driving excellence in software engineering practices.

This is a senior technical leadership role for a hands-on engineer who can operate across the full stack—from intuitive front-end applications to resilient backend services—while setting architectural direction, influencing engineering standards, and mentoring teams. The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise, platform thinking, and strong collaboration skills to build secure, scalable, Frontend and API-first solutions in a highly regulated environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Define and communicate the broader vision, executing the IT strategy in alignment with organizational standards

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, including architects, application owners, and engineers, to define overall strategy, prioritization, and execution

  • Establish epics and initiatives that align with strategic goals and support the product roadmap

  • Develop and maintain roadmaps that align critical business needs with scalable technical solutions

  • Leverage performance data to create feedback loops that drive continuous insight and improvement

  • Champion strong product management and agile mindsets by actively communicating team successes and identifying areas for growth

  • Build and lead high-performing teams capable of overcoming complex technical challenges to solve business-critical problems

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ progressive years of experience in defining and driving full stack software engineering, architecture and delivery cloud native platforms for large-scale distributed systems and digital platforms

  • 5+ years in hands on experience as senior/principal/architect roles building cloud native applications with cloud technologies such as GCP, AWS, AZURE, GKE, Google DBs (Bigquery, Spanner, BigTable) or other PaaS with deep expertise in API-first and microservices architectures

  • 5+ years of experience using front end development tools like Angular, React, React TypeScript, React JS

  • 5+ years of experience in building backend functionality using Python, API Forge, Rest API, Java

  • 5+ years of experience working in a Scrum iterative delivery, using Agile concepts such as Sprint planning, CI/CD

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience integrating AI/GenAI capabilities

Preferred Qualifications

  • 12+ years preferred with advanced STEM degree

  • Act as a technical advisor to engineering and product leadership

  • Influence cross-team technical direction and strategy

  • Establish and promote engineering best practices

  • Mentor and coach engineers across levels

  • Experience with AI development tools such as Cursor, Copilot, Vertex AI Studio, Claude Code, will be a plus

  • Experience building enterprise healthcare or regulated-industry platforms

  • Familiarity with healthcare data, privacy, and compliance requirements

  • Exposure to ML-Ops and AI lifecycle management

  • Experience with identity, security, and privacy architectures

  • Track record of influencing architecture across large organizations

  • Experience contributing to platform or developer ecosystem strategies

  • Strong foundational knowledge in AI, with prior experience using AI technologies such as OpenAI, Gemini, and Agentic AI automation

  • Experience in the healthcare domain

  • Experience with cloud networking and firewall implementation for new platforms.

  • Experience with application and database migration and modernization to the cloud

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field or equivalent experience

Pay Range

$144,200.00 - $288,400.00

This position is eligible for a CVS Health bonus, commission or short-term incentive program in addition to the base pay range listed above. This position also includes an award target in the company’s equity award program.

Description

Devereux has an exciting opportunity to become an Telehealth Therapist with our Florida Counseling Center.

** Must be license eligible in the state of Florida**

This is an Independent Contractor position

Devereux offers full-time, part-time, and contract options based on your preference. We have options that are ideal for both licensed and non-licensed clinicians. Our programs offer free supervision hours for licensure and flexible schedules for everyone! If this interests you, consider joining Devereux Advanced Behavioral Health as a Therapist!

Devereux’s Outpatient therapy programs provides telehealth mental health services for children and adolescents experiencing challenges such as anxiety, depression, trauma, behavioral concerns, and family conflict. The program is designed for youth who need structured therapeutic support but do not require residential or inpatient care, helping them remain stable at home and successful in school.

Being a Therapist with Devereux has its Advantages

Benefits and Rewards

We strive to create an inclusive environment, and retain the talented employees who make our organization a great place to work. We offer:

  • FREE Supervision hours for LMHC or LCSW licensure.

No matter what option you choose, you can earn the potential for up $80,000* or more; compensation increases based on productivity. Cases are provided by the leadership team. Compensation options will be discussed during interview process.

Qualifications

Education and Licensure:

  • Master's degree in the field of counseling, social work, or psychology field required

Other Requirements:

  • Must hold a minimum of at least 10 cases.
  • Successfully pass a Level 2 background screening with the State of Florida. To learn more visit:
  • Schedule: must be available for late afternoon; after-school hours are required to work with children over telehealth. Also needs to be available during business hours for training and supervision.

Devereux has a zero-tolerance policy for abuse and maintains policies and procedures to systematically reduce the risk of abuse to occur in our organization. Devereux fosters a culture of reporting abuse, and will cooperate with the authorities to the fullest extent possible.

For more information, please reach out us at .

Company Overview

Company Overview

Devereux is one of the nation’s largest nonprofit organizations, providing services, insight and leadership in the evolving field of behavioral healthcare. Founded in 1912, Devereux operates a comprehensive national network of clinical, therapeutic, educational and employment programs that positively impact the lives of 10,000+ children, adults – and their families – every year.

Our Mission: Devereux changes lives – by unlocking and nurturing human potential for people living with emotional, behavioral or cognitive differences.

With nearly 6,500 employees working in programs across the country, Devereux is a trusted partner for families, schools and communities, serving individuals in the areas of autism, intellectual and developmental disabilities, specialty mental health, education and foster care.

Our Culture, Our Expectations

At Devereux, Servant Leadership is embedded throughout our culture and every aspect of our organizational framework. Our mission-driven, people-first mindset is at the heart of the compassionate and high-quality programming we provide – every day – for the individuals and families we serve, and other key stakeholders. Devereux offers challenging and exciting work, and our team environment creates an empowering, positive and rewarding atmosphere. To be successful at Devereux, you will: put the needs of others first, feel called to serve and called to lead. As a member of our team, you will be a significant part of our commitment to providing a welcoming and supportive work environment across all programs and services, and within all policies and employee practices.

We believe a workplace rooted in inclusivity – offering a sense of belonging to all those who walk through our doors – is fundamental to delivering the highest quality healthcare services. Through open dialogue and the creation of brave spaces, we will engage in work that gives each of us a chance to change the world – one person, one family, one community at a time.

What Devereux Offers You

In addition to a competitive salary, Devereux provides a comprehensive health and welfare program to eligible full-time employees, family members and domestic partners. Eligible employees are eligible to start benefits after 30 days of employment. In addition, we offer;

  • Medical (including telemedicine via phone, web, app), dental, prescription drug, preventative care, and mental health services.
  • Student loan debt assistance, tuition reimbursement and continuing education assistance.
  • Generous time-off (start accruing 1st day), 403(b) retirement plan with matching benefit, and voluntary/employee paid supplemental life and accident coverage.
  • Employee assistance / work-life balance program.

Visit www.mydevereuxbenefits.org to see why Devereux is a great place to work!

Devereux is a drug-free workplace, drug screening required. EOE
